attributes.action: To make Gluten Free food for Coeliacs cheaper
attributes.background: Gluten free food is essential for those with Coeliac disease, and the cost of a gluten free loaf of bread is around 4 times higher than that of a typical loaf of bread. For something that is a necessity the cost is extortionate and costly to a lot of households.

rejection.details:
We already have petition open on reducing the cost of GF food, which you may wish to sign:
Make all manufactured gluten-free foods VAT-free & help reduce their cost
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/770300
